originality.rationale: Checked Brouwer SRG parameter tables (full-graph v,k,lambda,mu plus rf/sg only), MathWorld Shrikhande (parent spectrum (-2)^9 2^6 6^1, cospectrality with K4 square K4, intersection array {6,3;1,2}), MathWorld Rook (regular/perfect/vertex-transitive, chromatic number, no card spectra), MathWorld Cospectral Graphs ((4,4)-rook vs Shrikhande at n=16 as prominent pair, van Dam-Haemers programme, no deck data), MathWorld Clebsch (parent spectrum, uniqueness as SRG(16,5,0,2)), Brouwer DRG Shrikhande page (locally hexagon, Aut 192, independence/chromatic numbers of parents and complements, switching construction, no deletion-deck tables). None tabulates vertex-deletion card isomorphism types, card characteristic polynomials/spectra, irregular Hoffman ratios 1-lmax/lmin per card, Kirchhoff per-card tree counts, or the byte-identical cospectrality of the two 15-vertex cards. Cauchy interlacing constrains cards to intervals but does not imply exact card values. Parent clique numbers (Shrikhande omega 3 vs rook omega 4) are folklore and make the card-omega inequality unsurprising, but the exact card polynomials, the persistence of cospectrality to the 15-vertex cards despite non-isomorphism, the identical Hoffman ratios, and the exact tree-count pair 2177280000 vs 2176782336 are not recorded and not mechanically implied. A timestamp or failed search is not used as proof; comparison is substantive per source.

value.rationale: Strongest headline is self-contained and independently retrievable: singleton vertex-deletion decks for four canonical SRGs with exact card polynomials, documented cospectrality+Hoffman-equality of the Shrikhande/rook cards, and a rigorous clique/K4/Kirchhoff deck separator plus companion Petersen/Clebsch tables. Object was motivated before computation (reconstruction / van Dam-Haemers spectral-determination boundary; smallest cospectral SRG pair; Petersen smallest triangle-free SRG after C5; Clebsch unique SRG(16,5,0,2)) — not an arbitrary slice. Values were not known or mechanically implied (interlacing gives intervals, not exact polynomials/trees; card cospectrality does not follow from parent cospectrality). A future reconstruction/spectral-determination user could reasonably need the precise card polynomials, the boundary fact that spectrum+Hoffman fail while clique/trees succeed, and the reusable exhibits. This is an exact invariant of a natural object under the stated standard, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration. The admitted failure to find a spectral/Hoffman separator is reported honestly and does not erase the exact headline datum; no general theorem or completed broader census is demanded.
